trust_decision.summary: A caller- or disk-supplied file path is spliced into a shell_exec() command line inside hand-written double quotes instead of escapeshellarg(), so the path is trusted as inert shell text; the decision is made at each command-building line in the reader (shorten) and the writers (metaflac delete, vorbiscomment write).

landing_point.why: Summary says 'unescaped filenames' and the changelog says '(Windows)' (fix.diff:17); the Windows shorten branch sits directly above a Unix twin that already uses escapeshellarg (getid3/module.audio.shorten.php:148), so the gap is visible at a glance on the analyze() path.

fix_sites.entry_point: getID3::analyze() on a Shorten file (getid3/getid3.php:664), Windows branch only

getid3_writetags::DeleteTags() (getid3/write.php:422,458-461), also via WriteTags() with remove_other_tags (getid3/write.php:318-319); or getid3_write_metaflac::DeleteMetaFLAC() directly; Windows branch

getid3_writetags::WriteTags() (getid3/write.php:137,369-373) and DeleteTags() (getid3/write.php:450-453 -> DeleteVorbisComment -> WriteVorbisComment, getid3/write.vorbiscomment.php:127-129); Windows branch
getID3::getHashdata() for Ogg Vorbis (getid3/getid3.php:1791); fix commit 2c6f3f9 is ALREADY applied at the pinned commit

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: getid3/write.metaflac.php:200 and getid3/write.vorbiscomment.php:105 (non-Windows branches of the writer classes, reached via getid3/write.php:369-389,450-462); the report's '(Windows)' label (fix.diff:17) points away from them

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory/changelog says 'unescaped command paths (Windows)', and WriteMetaFLAC on both platforms already escapes (getid3/write.metaflac.php:116-120,141-145), so a solver can argue the Unix writer branches and the separate DeleteMetaFLAC function were never in scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Tag writing/deleting and Shorten analysis must keep working for legitimate filenames containing spaces, apostrophes or quotes (common in music libraries) and for Windows path translation of the whole command line; a reject-metacharacters fix breaks these, and the published Delete fix itself appends a stray '"' that breaks DeleteMetaFLAC.

O6_input_shapes: reader path: $info['filenamepath'] built from realpath(dirname)+basename (getid3/getid3.php:605-607) into shorten command
writer path: raw caller-supplied $this->filename into metaflac/vorbiscomment commands
Windows branch vs non-Windows branch of each builder
temporary comments file path ($tempcommentsfilename from tempnam) escaped alongside the filename (getid3/write.vorbiscomment.php:90,105)

O7_producer.where: filenamepath is produced in getID3::openfile (getid3/getid3.php:605-607) but it is plain path normalisation, not a producer the check misses

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Writer filename starting with '-' is passed to metaflac/vorbiscomment as an option (escapeshellarg does not stop option injection; no '--' separator), including the already-escaped WriteMetaFLAC route
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is argument injection (CWE-88), not shell metacharacters, and the path is already escaped; plus filenames from analyze() are absolute so only the writer path is affected.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same files as the fix (write.metaflac.php, write.vorbiscomment.php); filename enters at getid3/write.php:384

O8b_injection_room.sibling: getFileSizeSyscall builds a dir/ls command from a path; a version without escapeshellarg on one platform branch
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same platform-split command-building idiom already used for large-file sizing; a maintainer adding a Windows 'for %I' variant could easily quote by hand as in the fixed sites.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: 8.3 short-name lookup 'dir /x' over a path component list
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Startup helper path discovery shell-calls with path segments; hand-quoting there would match the pre-fix style in write.*.php.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a helper-locator ('which <binary>') parameterised by a configurable binary name/path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Reader modules that shell out to external decoders follow this template; a second decoder module (e.g. another lossless format) is realistic distance from the writer code.

O9_family: OS command injection (CWE-78) via filename in shell_exec command lines; adjacent argument injection

O10_build.toolchain: PHP CLI (5.3-8.5 per CI), composer for lint/phpstan only
O10_build.project_tests: None for this area: no test suite in repo; CI runs only lint and PHPStan (.github/workflows/continuous-integration.yml:44-59). Exercising sinks needs stub metaflac/vorbiscomment/shorten binaries on PATH; Windows branches reachable by pre-defining GETID3_OS_ISWINDOWS/GETID3_HELPERAPPSDIR (getid3/getid3.php:13-14,471).

j.j_sites_touched: getid3/module.audio.shorten.php, getid3/write.metaflac.php, getid3/write.vorbiscomment.php (getid3/getid3.php hunk already present at pin; demos/demo.mysqli.php hunk is echo-only, no command sink)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap only the Windows shorten command (mirroring line 148) and stop, or reject filenames containing quotes/metacharacters.

out_of_scope_notes: GETID3_HELPERAPPSDIR is concatenated unescaped into commands (getid3/module.audio.shorten.php:135, getid3/write.metaflac.php:184); it is operator configuration, not attacker input.
demos/demo.mysqli.php hunks (fix.diff:45-68) only change echoed rename scripts; no command is executed there.
unverified: Fix commit 2c6f3f9 (getid3/getid3.php getHashdata) is an ancestor of the pinned merge and already applied at getid3/getid3.php:1843,1854; only ce598c4 (+ version bump 0bc49be) remains to apply. Not a listed red flag, but the task host has one fewer site than c_fix_sites suggests.
tiny_repo: repo size not measured (no shell run); flagged from file listing (~90 PHP source files in getid3/, no assets), estimated well under 5 MB.
O8 route is argument injection (CWE-88); whether the advisory's property ('unescaped filenames') covers it is a judgement call; present_in_latest unknown (no latest release given).
Whether PHP's Windows escapeshellarg (quote-wrap, replacing % ! ") fully neutralises cmd.exe metacharacters at the Windows sites was not analysed.
Published fix at fix.diff:102,111 leaves an unbalanced '"' after escapeshellarg in DeleteMetaFLAC; hidden tests should not use the published fix verbatim as the reference for that function.
